decision: Separate spatial/clock comparison from color fidelity. Remove only constant channel bias, retain all raw differences and compare adjacent frames. Color fidelity remains unaccepted; the threshold was not raised.

heightCalibration.cause: Tick plane is behind the front faces of the bars. Parallel perspective planes have different projected scales.
heightCalibration.correction: Use grid ticks plus one common bar-zero baseline to calibrate parallel-plane scale about image center; no per-bar top anchors are used. Keep 3-pixel tolerance.
